capabilities: Automatically highlight configured keywords as you type them in notes
Add, edit, and remove keywords with custom font and background colors
Define regular expression patterns for advanced keyword matching
extras: Ships with three predefined keywords (TODO, ADD, FIXME); installation via the Community Plugin Store or manual placement in the plugins folder.
motivation: The author built it for users who deal with large volumes of text and need a quick way to identify key concepts.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to automatically emphasize specific keywords like TODO or FIXME wherever they appear in notes.
summary: Keyword highlighter that automatically highlights user-configured keywords and regex patterns in notes with custom font and background colors.
